LanguageData.LP_Sub_ShadowWay.label: Way of Shadow
LanguageData.LP_Sub_ShadowWay.description: A monk who trains in darkness: releases magical darkness, teleports between dark places, becomes an invisible shadow, and seizes the openings when companions hit enemies to follow up. "Darkness" means cells with under 30% light (outdoors at night, rooms without lights).
LanguageData.LP_Sub_OpenHandWay.label: Way of the Open Hand
LanguageData.LP_Sub_OpenHandWay.description: The ultimate master of martial technique: every punch of Flurry of Blows can knock down, push or disrupt enemies, heals oneself with ki, carries a protective aura after waking, and finally learns the quivering palm that can be detonated days later.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Evocation.label: School of Evocation
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Evocation.description: Hone destructive spells to perfection: evocation spells (magic missile, fireball, lightning bolt, disintegrate) don't hurt allies, magic missile is stronger, damage adds Intelligence, and overchannel can double a spell; the price is backlash when used again the same day.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Scribes.label: Order of Scribes
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Scribes.description: A wizard who converses with the spellbook: the wizardly quill makes reading scrolls never fail, the awakened spellbook changes fireball and lightning damage types, manifest mind makes spells temporarily free, an extra scroll appears each day on waking, and the spellbook takes a hit for you in a crisis.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_DragonWay.label: Way of the Ascendant Dragon
LanguageData.LP_Sub_DragonWay.description: A monk who imitates great dragons with ki: unarmed strikes carry a dragon's element, breathe dragon breath, spectral dragon wings unfold during Step of the Wind, and finally become an ancient dragon, panicking enemies and protecting companions. The dragon's element is switched with the "draconic strike" button between fire, cold, lightning, acid and poison, and breath of the dragon and ancient dragon stance follow it.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_CircleLand.label: Circle of the Land
LanguageData.LP_Sub_CircleLand.description: Bound to the land underfoot: land's spell changes with the map's climate (cold / temperate / desert / humid, judged by the tile's temperature and rainfall; biomes from mods like Alpha Biomes work too), and can permanently reshape terrain: dig lakes, make marshes, turn mud into rich soil.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_CircleSpores.label: Circle of Spores
LanguageData.LP_Sub_CircleSpores.description: Sees life in decay: halo of spores, touch of rot, symbiosis with spores, and enemy corpses sprout fungus and stand up to fight for you. The halo of spores is stronger with fungal plants such as glowstool and agarilux nearby.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_CircleStars.label: Circle of Stars
LanguageData.LP_Sub_CircleStars.description: A druid who reads the stars: guiding bolts of starlight, becoming constellations (the archer shoots, the chalice heals, the dragon steadies the mind), and a daily cosmic omen that protects allies or curses enemies. Casting is stronger outdoors at night.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_LifeDomain.label: Life Domain
LanguageData.LP_Sub_LifeDomain.description: A cleric who protects life: stronger healing spells, better medicine and surgery; Channel Divinity "preserve life" heals a group of allies at once. Channel Divinity once per day (twice at level 6, three times at 18), no divinity cost.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_LightDomain.label: Light Domain
LanguageData.LP_Sub_LightDomain.description: A cleric who brings light: a dazzling flare makes enemy attacks miss, light illuminates the dark, and radiance of the dawn dispels magical darkness and invisibility. A counter to enemies who rely on "darkness" such as Way of Shadow, shadow magic and Gloom Stalkers. Channel Divinity once per day (twice at level 6, three times at 18).
LanguageData.LP_Sub_ForgeDomain.label: Forge Domain
LanguageData.LP_Sub_ForgeDomain.description: A cleric of the forge god: enchants gear +1 each day, conjures excellent-quality weapons from steel, is tougher in heavy armor, and finally fears no fire. Crafting speed +10%.
